name: Nansen
tagline: On-chain analytics and wallet intelligence API for crypto research and monitoring.
description: Nansen provides institutional-grade on-chain data and wallet labeling APIs for tracking smart money, token flows, and portfolio activity across major blockchains. Developers use it for research, alerts, and analytics products that need labeled addresses and historical chain data.
